name: Schwarzsee Kitzbühel
kurzbeschreibung: Moor lake about two kilometres west of Kitzbühel with the Städtisches Schwarzseebad, sunbathing lawns and views of the Kaisergebirge.
beschreibung:
The Schwarzsee is a moor lake and lies about two kilometres west of Kitzbühel at an elevation of 762 metres. With an area of around 16 hectares and a maximum water depth of eight metres, it is one of the warmest swimming lakes in the Alps; in high summer the water warms up pleasantly and shimmers emerald green.

On the lakeshore, the town of Kitzbühel operates the Städtisches Schwarzseebad with well-tended sunbathing lawns. Parts of the shore area are designated as a nature reserve, and from the shore there are views of the Kaisergebirge. A walking path leads around the lake, which is used for ice skating in winter when the lake is frozen over.
